verdict.rationale: Payroll/HR platforms can plausibly offer new-hire self-onboarding, so this axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions sending new hires a self-serve flow for W-4, I-9, or bank/direct-deposit details. The 'onboarding' items (docs-24, docs-25) describe setting up the employer's own Paychex account, and the employee self-service mentions cover punches, pay stubs, and W-2s, which are adjacent features that earn no credit here.
